sql: SELECT 'A_since_arm_0207T0201' AS window, strategy AS tag, count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL)::text AS closed_n, to_char(COALESCE(SUM(pnl) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL),0),'FM990.0000') AS pnl_usd, to_char(COALESCE(AVG(pnl) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL),0)*100,'FM990.00') AS cents_per_trade, to_char(COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(pnl) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL),0)*100,'FM990.00') AS sd_cents, count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND pnl > 0)::text AS wins, count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND pnl < 0)::text AS losses, count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NULL)::text AS still_open FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4','mmsell10','Gmmsell0','Gmmsell1') AND created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'B_G_arms_since_0906', strategy, count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL)::text, to_char(COALESCE(SUM(pnl) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL),0),'FM990.0000'), to_char(COALESCE(AVG(pnl) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL),0)*100,'FM990.00'), to_char(COALESCE(STDDEV_SAMP(pnl) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL),0)*100,'FM990.00'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND pnl > 0)::text, count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND pnl < 0)::text, count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NULL)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Gmmsell0','Gmmsell1') AND created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-06 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
